require the public entities specified in subparagraph (i), (ii)

furnish regular reports or any other information on ad – hoc
basis –

(a)
which  are  necessary  for  the  preparation  of  the

(b)
on matters relating to their financial management.
(2)  The  Head  of  every  public  entity  shall  furnish  the
information  and  reports  required  to  be  furnished  by  the
Secretary  to  the  Treasury  under  subsection  (1)  within  the
timeframe and in the form specified by the Secretary to the
Treasury.
